name: Schroeder Furniture & Flooring
old_description: Schroeder Furniture & Flooring is an independently owned and operated business since 1947. Visit our conveniently located showroom to see many varieties and styles of furniture, flooring, and much more.
about:
Schroeder Furniture & Flooring has served Langdon, North Dakota since 1947 as an independently owned and operated business. Founded in the post-war era, the company has remained under independent ownership for over seven decades. It operates a showroom on Highway 5 West where it displays a broad selection of home furnishings and building materials.

The showroom stocks furniture, flooring, tile, mattresses, lighting, window treatments, home accents, décor, and paint. Beyond retail, the company provides professional installation services for hardwood, vinyl tile, and carpet flooring using licensed and insured installers. Free delivery within a 70-mile radius is available for furniture, mattresses, and other large purchases, a service highlighted as a customer convenience.

The business primarily serves residential customers across Langdon and the surrounding region, supporting homeowners engaged in renovation, new construction, or furnishing projects. Schroeder is a member of the National Federation of Independent Business, reflecting its small-business orientation and commitment to independent enterprise.

The company emphasizes a hands-on showroom experience, promoting style, selection, and satisfaction as core values. Its decades-long presence in the community underscores a focus on personal customer relationships and local service, with the team positioning itself as the area's local flooring experts.

name: Schwan's Pizza Plant
old_description: The company is incorporated as Schwan’s Sales Enterprises, Inc., and Marvin’s older brother, Alfred, joins the company. Marvin’s younger brother, Robert, had also been working for the company since 1948.
about:
Schwan's Pizza Plant, operating as part of CJ Schwan's, is headquartered in Salina, Kansas. The company traces its roots to 1948 when Robert Schwan began working for the business founded by his brothers Marvin and Alfred Schwan. Originally established as a Minnesota dairy operation in the 1950s, the business was incorporated as Schwan's Sales Enterprises, Inc., and has since evolved into a large-scale U.S.-based food manufacturer.

Today the company produces a wide range of frozen and prepared foods for retail grocery, K-12 school nutrition programs, restaurants, healthcare facilities, convenience stores, and college and university dining halls. With approximately 9,000 employees and multiple production facilities across the country, the operation focuses on culinary innovation, ingredient quality, and food safety to supply both branded and private-label products.

Its customer base spans the foodservice and retail channels, including school districts, hospital systems, restaurant operators, and convenience-store distributors. The company's portfolio includes family-favorite brands that are distributed internationally through its affiliation with CJ Foods, a global food conglomerate.

The business emphasizes carefully selected ingredients and rigorous food-safety standards as its core differentiators, aiming to create a world of flavors for every table through consistent quality and innovation.

name: Sea Bright Solar
old_description: Sea Bright Solar uses the power of the sun to help customers from coast to coast save money—and the planet! Since 2003, Sea Bright Solar has helped thousands of homeowners and businesses generate their own renewable energy and reduce or eliminate their reliance on the grid. Serving New Jersey, New York, and Southern California, we provide customized, turnkey solar solutions. Our team consists of professional residential and commercial solar consultants, designers, engineers, and installation teams. Sea Bright offers extensive industry knowledge of the latest technology and best practices, as well as solar financing and incentives. Through our innovative solar system installations, we have helped both homeowners and businesses benefit by cutting energy costs up to 100%.
about:
Sea Bright Solar was founded in 2003 in Ocean Township, New Jersey. The company began with a focus on helping homeowners and businesses generate renewable energy through solar power, expanding over time to serve customers across New Jersey, New York, and Southern California.

The firm provides turnkey solar and home energy solutions. Its services span solar photovoltaic system design and installation, battery storage (including EcoFlow and SolarEdge systems), EV charging stations, and a Home Upgrade division that handles roofing (GAF-certified), siding (Norandex), gutters, whole-home generators (Generac), and main electrical panel upgrades. The company operates from three locations — Ocean, NJ; Staten Island, NY; and Redlands, CA — and holds active contractor licenses in each jurisdiction.

Sea Bright Solar serves residential and commercial customers seeking energy independence and lower utility costs. Its client base includes homeowners looking to combine solar with roofing or backup power, as well as businesses pursuing sustainability goals. The company also works with customers adding electric vehicles or planning home expansions that increase energy demand.

The company differentiates itself by consolidating multiple trades — roofing, electrical, solar, and generator installation — under a single licensed team, aiming to simplify project management and accountability. It emphasizes the use of high-performance, professional-grade products and over 20 years of combined experience.

old_description: Founded by a six-generation packaging company in 1991, SeaCa Packaging expanded the family legacy of reliable service, commitment to deliveries and customer focused approach by providing high quality graphic packaging to Central California.
about:
SeaCa Packaging operates from Dinuba, California, in the heart of the Central Valley. The company was established in 1991 by the owners of Seattle‑Tacoma Box Company, a family business founded in 1889 that had already passed through six generations. SeaCa was created to extend that legacy of reliable service and on‑time delivery to growers and packers in Central California.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures printed corrugated boxes, plastic corrugated (polypropylene) containers, and wooden packaging. It also provides value‑added services such as structural design and graphic printing. The operation serves agricultural, industrial, and seafood customers, though the facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Primary markets include the fruit, vegetable, and seafood sectors along the West Coast. SeaCa’s corrugated and plastic packaging is used for harvesting, shipping, and display of fresh produce, while its wooden crates and bins support heavier industrial and seafood applications.

SeaCa emphasizes its family heritage, a customer‑focused approach, and a commitment to sustainable packaging solutions. The company says its six‑generation experience allows it to deliver practical, innovative packaging that helps clients stand out in competitive markets.

name: Seattle-Tacoma Box Co
old_description: Founded by a six-generation packaging company in 1991, SeaCa Packaging expanded the family legacy of reliable service, commitment to deliveries and customer focused approach by providing high quality graphic packaging to Central California.
about:
Seattle-Tacoma Box Company has operated from Kent, Washington since 1889, making it one of the oldest continuously family-owned packaging firms in the Pacific Northwest. The business traces its roots through six generations of the founding family, who have maintained ownership and operational control since the late 19th century. In 1991 the family expanded its footprint by launching SeaCa Packaging to serve Central California with graphic packaging, and in 2014 added SeaCa Plastic Packaging for sustainable polypropylene corrugated products. A sister operation, Commencement Bay Corrugated, was established in the early 1980s as an independent corrugated plant jointly owned by the presidents of Seattle-Tacoma Box Company and Pacific Container Company.

The company manufactures a full range of corrugated, plastic, and wooden packaging at dedicated wood and corrugated plants. Capabilities include custom structural design, printing, and die-cutting for produce bins, shipping containers, and retail-ready packaging. While specific facility dimensions and headcount are not disclosed, the combined operations serve high-volume agricultural harvest cycles across the region.

Primary customers are growers, packers, and shippers in the fruit, vegetable, and seafood sectors throughout Washington, Oregon, and California. The packaging is engineered for cold-chain durability, ventilation, and brand presentation, with documented use cases in apple, berry, and salmon supply chains.

The firm emphasizes its multi-generational expertise and a sustainability platform built on certified forest content, certified sourcing, and recycled materials. The family ownership model is cited as the foundation for long-term customer relationships and consistent service through seasonal demand spikes.

name: Secure Semiconductor Manufacturing, LLC Office
old_description: At Secure Semiconductor Manufacturing LLC, we specialize in fast-turn, high-reliability PCB assembly and electronic manufacturing services for innovators, engineers, and hardware startups. Whether you’re building the next big thing in defense, aerospace, medical, or advanced commercial tech, we provide precision manufacturing with the security and confidentiality your IP demands.
about:
Secure Semiconductor Manufacturing, LLC (SSM) operates from Lebo, Kansas, as a 100% American-owned and operated advanced electronics manufacturer. The company was founded with a mission to restore critical electronics manufacturing capabilities to the United States by providing secure, reliable, and high-quality PCB fabrication and assembly services for commercial, industrial, aerospace, defense, medical, energy, telecommunications, and critical infrastructure markets.

SSM provides printed circuit board (PCB) fabrication, printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), surface mount technology (SMT) assembly, through-hole assembly, and mixed-technology assembly including RF. The facility supports prototype through low-to-medium volume production with quick-turn manufacturing, design for manufacturability (DFM) support, automated optical inspection (AOI), quality inspection and testing, conformal coating, potting, high-density interconnect (HDI) and controlled impedance capabilities, counterfeit component prevention, and traceability. Workmanship meets IPC-A-610 Class 3 standards.

The company serves aerospace and avionics, defense and government contracting, medical devices and health technology, energy and industrial automation, telecommunications and wireless infrastructure, as well as commercial and industrial innovators. SSM also supports startups and commercial product developers with scalable, cost-effective PCB solutions, full engineering support, BOM optimization, component sourcing, and rapid domestic prototyping.

SSM differentiates itself through 100% U.S.-based manufacturing, ITAR registration, AS9100 and ISO 9001 certified processes, full confidentiality and traceability, and responsive engineering support. Its stated mission extends beyond manufacturing to eliminating reliance on offshore electronics production, enhancing national security and supply chain resiliency, fostering domestic economic growth, and delivering environmentally responsible manufacturing.

name: Selco Products Company
old_description: Since 1958, Selco Products has served a wide variety of markets on a strong yet simple foundation of personal service. With corporate headquarters in Reno, Nevada, our sales force consists of direct and manufacturer representatives and authorized distributors throughout North America and Mexico.
about:
Founded in 1958 in Reno, Nevada, Selco Products began as a family-owned business built on personal service in the temperature control market. The company maintains its corporate headquarters in Reno and operates a sales network of direct representatives and authorized distributors across North America and Mexico.

Selco designs and manufactures a broad line of temperature controls, including disc thermostats, remote capillary controls, probe thermostats, NTC thermistors with interchangeable accuracies of ±0.05°C to ±1.0°C, electronic temperature controls, thermal protectors, digital panel meters, and custom wire harness assemblies. Manufacturing capabilities span mechanical engineering, probe design, PCB layout (AutoCAD, SolidWorks), SMT pick-and-place (Juki), convection reflow (Lovell), wave soldering, epoxy potting, and wire cutting, stripping, and crimping. Production runs from prototypes to full volume, supported by a Reno facility and exclusive manufacturing partnerships in Brazil, China, Italy, Mexico, Japan, and Taiwan.

The company serves HVAC, medical, electronics, professional audio, industrial instrumentation, power supply, food service, appliances, process controls, telecommunications, aerospace, and laboratory markets. Customers include foodservice equipment makers such as Proluxe and AJ Antunes, ice machine manufacturer Ice-O-Matic, compressor supplier VMAC, and a German freezestat producer that transitioned four models to Selco. Distributors handle small-quantity and repair orders.

Selco’s stated mission is to manufacture and supply quality, innovative thermal management products with outstanding worldwide service. Differentiators cited include an ISO 9001:2015 quality system, just-in-time and Kanban inventory programs, same-day shipping from Reno for stocked parts, engineering support with thermal testing and failure analysis, a one-year warranty, and free samples in most cases.

name: Selvaggio Steel, Inc.
old_description: One of the most trusted, family-owned steel shops in the State of Illinois, Selvaggio Steel represents exceptional production capacity, state-of-the art technology, and a reputation for accuracy, timely delivery, and professionalism.
about:
Selvaggio Steel, Inc. operates from Springfield, Illinois, where it was founded in 1957 by Joe Selvaggio after he returned from World War II. Joe, supported by his wife Helen and his brother Jasper, started the business as Selvaggio Ornamental & Structural Steel Inc., building a reputation for custom ornamental ironwork. The company remains family-owned, now led by the second generation—sons Mark and Tony, who began as teenagers on the shop floor, and daughter Michelle, who joined as comptroller.

The shop provides structural steel fabrication and ornamental ironwork, handling drilling, punching, welding, shearing, torch burning, brake pressing, and plate rolling. Its 30-person crew runs a highly automated facility equipped with a CNC beam drill line with robotic coping, CNC angle fabricator, CNC plate punch with plasma cutting, CNC profile and plate rolls, and a 400-ton brake press. Detailing is done in-house using the SDS/2 3D CAD system, and the shop also offers sandblasting, special coatings, field installation, and crane rental with a 110-foot boom.

Customers include healthcare projects such as the Koke Mill Medical Center and Memorial Medical Center’s emergency department and pedestrian walkway, along with commercial and residential builders needing structural steel, stairs, rails, columns, trellises, and custom metalwork. The company’s warehouse supplies raw steel—plate, pipe, tubing, stainless, decking, and structural shapes—in quantities from a single piece to full truckloads.

Selvaggio Steel distinguishes itself through early technology adoption: it was the first Illinois fabricator to use 3D CAD for steel and secured AISC certification in 2007, regarded as the industry’s gold standard. Millions invested in automation have consolidated multiple operations into single-button processes, reducing labor and lead times. The family’s guiding principle—treating others as they wish to be treated—underpins long-standing client and supplier relationships.

name: SemiGen, Inc
old_description: SemiGen was founded in 2009 with a vision of being a multi-faceted and an invaluable partner to the world’s leading electronic device manufacturers. Recognizing that a manufacturer can quickly find themselves short on time, talent, and supplies, we’ve thought ahead and are now fully-prepared to be an on-demand extension of your engineering team and production facility, and a trusted link in your supply chain.
about:
SemiGen, Inc. was founded in 2009 in Londonderry, New Hampshire, to serve as a multi‑faceted partner for electronic device manufacturers. The company operates a 43,000‑square‑foot facility with 20,000 square feet of clean‑room space, housing RF/microwave assembly, automated PCB assembly, and testing under one roof. Now a subsidiary of Naprotek (an Edgewater Capital Partners portfolio company), SemiGen acts as an on‑demand extension of customers’ engineering and production teams.

SemiGen manufactures its own semiconductor and passive components — PIN, Schottky, and step‑recovery diodes, thin‑film circuits, filters, and attenuators — while also providing contract manufacturing: thermo‑compression and ultrasonic wire bonding, ball bonding, fine‑pitch and BGA PCB assembly, and box‑build. Its in‑house ion‑beam foundry offers thin‑film processing, metallization, wafer dicing, and ion‑beam milling. A test lab supports RF/microwave performance testing and high‑reliability MIL‑STD screening up to 50 GHz. Over $3 million in recent equipment investments supports capacity.

The company serves military electronics, commercial products, and medical instrumentation markets, with compliance to space‑level MIL‑PRF‑38534 and military MIL‑PRF‑19500, 750, and 883 specs. SemiGen holds CMMC 2.0 Level 2 certification for defense cybersecurity and earned a BAE Systems Partner 2 Win Silver Tier Award. Customers include prime defense contractors and OEMs needing high‑reliability RF/microwave hybrids and component‑level screening.

SemiGen combines product supply — via its RF Supply Store stocking bonding tools and materials — with manufacturing, testing, and foundry services. Its quality system is ISO 9001:2015 certified and built around military‑spec compliance. The firm emphasizes workforce training, cross‑training, and lessons‑learned reviews to reduce risk on repeat jobs, positioning itself as a supply‑chain link for time‑critical, high‑frequency programs.
